title: Oh Kuang Eng buys S$453K of Mi Material Holding Limited shares
body: Oh Kuang Eng bought 440,000 shares of Mi Material Holding Limited in a market transaction at S$1.029 per share, for a total of S$452,777. Total interest rises from 376,285,000 shares (76.02%) to 376,725,000 shares (76.11%).
deemed_interest_text: Mr. Oh Kuang Eng ("Mr. Oh") holds approximately 45.4% direct interest in the issued and paid up share capital of Mi Technovation Berhad ("MiTB"). MiTB holds 366,000,000 ordinary shares in the issued share capital of the Company. In addition, Ms. Yong Shiao Voon ("Ms. Yong"), an associate of Mr. Oh, holds 1,835,000 ordinary shares in the issued share capital of the Company. Accordingly, for the purpose of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 and the Securities and Futures (Disclosure of Interests) Regulation 2012, Mr. Oh has a deemed interest in the 367,835,000 ordinary shares held by MiTB and Ms. Yong.
remarks_text: The percentage of shareholdings set out above immediately before and after the transaction are calculated based on the issued share capital of the Company of 495,000,000 ordinary shares as at 20 November 2026.

title: Mapletree Logistics Trust Management Ltd's stake in Mapletree Logistics Trust rises to 0.29% from 0.12% in payment of management fees
body: Mapletree Logistics Trust Management Ltd's stake in Mapletree Logistics Trust moved from 0.12% to 0.29% in payment of management fees. The transaction involved 8,677,674 units at S$1.1014 per unit, for a total of S$9,557,590. Total interest rises from 6,290,361 units (0.12%) to 14,968,035 units (0.29%).
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholdings before and after the transaction is calculated based on 5,148,894,098 units issued.
change_reason: payment of base fee, property and lease management fees using newly issued units

title: Mapletree Logistics Trust Management Ltd reports change in interest in Mapletree Logistics Trust
body: Mapletree Logistics Trust Management Ltd reported a change in interest in Mapletree Logistics Trust. The filing attributes the change to the nomination of another party to receive newly issued units payable to it. The transaction involved 8,677,674 units at S$1.1014 per unit, for a total of S$9,557,590. Total interest falls from 14,968,035 units (0.29%) to 6,290,361 units (0.12%).
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholdings before and after the transaction is calculated based on 5,148,894,098 units issued.
change_reason: the nomination of another party to receive newly issued units payable to it

title: Kuok Khoon Hong's deemed interest in Wilmar International Ltd rises after S$1.4M share purchase
body: Kuok Khoon Hong's deemed interest in Wilmar International Ltd rose after Hong Lee Holdings (Pte) Ltd bought 500,000 shares at S$2.85 per share, for a total of S$1,425,000. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 898,180,935 shares (14.38%) to 898,680,935 shares (14.39%).
deemed_interest_text: Mr Kuok Khoon Hong is deemed to be interested in the Wilmar shares held by (a) Madam Yong Lee Lee (spouse), (b)  HPRY Holdings Limited, HPR Investments Limited, Hong Lee Holdings (Pte) Ltd, Kuok Hock Swee & Sons Sdn Bhd, Longhlin Asia Limited, KHS (Hong Kong) Limited and Jaygar Holdings Limited, and (c) trusts controlled by him.
remarks_text: The percentages are computed based on  6,244,255,856 voting shares (excluding treasury shares) in Wilmar as at 20 November 2026.
change_reason: the acquisition of 500,000 shares via a market transaction by a company in which the holder is deemed interested
